environment: Two disposable ARM64 Linux Podman VMs sequentially, each 1 CPU and 2 GiB RAM; local XFS; test-owned processes stopped and VMs removed

direct.observed: Missing watermark, skipped epoch, invalid ballot and malformed value refused without advancing watermark. A fresh first and next epoch initialized and voted. Deleting an already-seen epoch file caused refusal; the bypass mutant recreated it. An existing lock refused and remained; the lock-bypass mutant voted and removed it. Watermark advanced without a state file refused that epoch. Missing watermark refused. Topology-member predicate was stubbed.

groupIntegration.observed: Three group servers, signed test topology, synthetic token and a native group client chose epochs 1 and 2. After one epoch-1 state file was removed the quorum adopted the original epoch-1 value without recreating that file. After a second was removed, no majority was chosen and neither file was recreated. An initial 1-second readiness attempt failed before servers listened; a later run waited for all three loopback listeners.

limits: A provisioned watermark and local serialization are required. A stale directory snapshot can roll back both watermark and epoch files; this is not an external monotonic or membership authority. Lock orphan recovery, crash/power-loss, admission quotas, existing-state migration, multi-host failure isolation, Tailscale confidentiality, actual bots and model inference remain unqualified.
